notes.title: Puppet Seed - Gameplay Trailer #1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=m-V-gRceLeU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]A Single Player Open World Exploration game with an emphasis on creating character builds for not just your player character, but a team of interchangeable AI Companions that you can acquire throughout your travels. Stats, Perks, Weapons, Modular Armor/Clothing and Skills can be chosen as you level up your entire team through combat, looting and buying from town vendors.[/b]

Humanoid and monster companions can be acquired from 8 races, each with their own regions, settlements and elemental strengths and weaknesses - Team composition is key to survive when travelling through different areas of the world map. 

Explore the frozen surface of Echora on foot as well as using your player owned vehicle, defeating opponents in a non-linear, sandbox world.

My reason for creating [b]Puppet Seed[/b] is simply to combine two game features which are individually popular but rarely seen together - Permanent, customizable AI Companions and a seamless, non level-gated, 3D Open World.
